_about: Hand-verified building facts used by finder.py (style, year built, stories, reviews). Checked 2026-10-31. 'style' == 'garden' is rejected; year_built < --min-year is rejected unless fully_renovated.

Passport Apartments Herndon.reviews: RentCafe 4.5 (22); Birdeye 3.8 (132); Yelp 2.8 (6). Complaints: fire alarms, elevator outages, leaks in heavy rain, visitor parking.
Passport Apartments Herndon.fees: Trash $35/mo; amenity fee $400/yr; admin $250 one-time; parking $25-75/mo optional.

The Point at Ridgeline.reviews: ApartmentRatings 4.7; Yelp 3.9 (13). Complaints: thin walls/noise, sirens, balcony flooding, garage door, visitor parking fee.
The Point at Ridgeline.fees: Trash $15/mo; utility admin $4.51/mo; water/sewer billed with rent; amenity $500 one-time; garage parking $75.
The Point at Ridgeline.notes: Plans marked (WDU) are Fairfax County Workforce Dwelling Units (80/100/120% AMI).

The Point at Monroe Place.reviews: ApartmentRatings 4.7; Birdeye 3.8 (101); Yelp 4.0 (9). Complaints: fee increases, compact washer/dryer, pool heating, small gym.
The Point at Monroe Place.fees: Valet trash ~$35/mo; utility admin ~$4.50/mo; water/sewer billed with rent; amenity $500 move-in + $300/yr renewal; parking $45-60.

Ashton at Dulles Corner.reviews: Google 3.7 (721, shown on Bozzuto page); ApartmentRatings 3.8 (297); Apartments.com 4.2 (135); Yelp 2.4 (61). Complaints: slow maintenance, water outages, fire alarms, thin walls.
Ashton at Dulles Corner.fees: Fixed $44.05/mo (valet trash, trash, stormwater, admin, pest) + usage water/sewer/gas; amenity $250/lease.
Ashton at Dulles Corner.notes: rent.com shows total price incl. $44.05 fixed fees; official base rent is ~$45 lower.

Skymark.reviews: ApartmentRatings 4.6 (4); Apartments.com 1 review (1 star). Complaints: slow management, long elevator waits.
Skymark.notes: All sub-$2,180 1BRs are WDU (income-restricted, $1,995 base). Cheapest market-rate 1BR $2,240.

Faraday Park.reviews: Google 4.5 (225); Apartments.com/ForRent 4.8 (256). Complaints: low light, limited storage, garage vandalism, noise.
Faraday Park.notes: Only sub-$2,180 1BR is a junior (JR) plan whose bedroom appears windowless. Cheapest regular 1BR $2,373.

Camden Monument Place.notes: rent.com prices are 15-month-lease prices; 12-month quotes are ~$290-300 higher (none under $2,180).
